name: defensive_interval_ratio_days
question_template: A firm holds cash {CASH} USD, marketable securities {SEC} USD, accounts receivable {AR} USD, and inventory {INV} USD. Annual operating expenses are {OPEX} USD, of which {DEP} USD is non-cash depreciation. Defensive assets include only cash, marketable securities, and receivables. Daily cash operating expenses are the cash portion of annual operating expenses spread evenly over {DAYS} days. Compute the defensive interval ratio, i.e. the number of days the defensive assets can cover daily cash operating expenses. Use exact arithmetic.

slots.description: Daily cash operating expenses in USD per day.

program:
def solve():
    cash = P["CASH"]
    sec = P["SEC"]
    ar = P["AR"]
    opex = P["OPEX"]
    dep = P["DEP"]
    days = P["DAYS"]
    if dep >= opex:
        raise ValueError("depreciation must be less than operating expenses")
    defensive = Fraction(cash + sec + ar)
    daily = Fraction(opex - dep, days)
    if daily <= 0:
        raise ValueError("daily cash expenses must be positive")
    dir_days = defensive / daily
    return {"final": dir_days, "defensive_assets_total": defensive, "daily_cash_opex": daily}
